text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Sigh… What a beautiful clover. Just looking at it soothes my soul…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I can't lose heart over something like this, but my legs just won't move how they should…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: If I push too hard, however, I'll only end up injuring myself, and this will be all for naught.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm going to head back to the dorm early today. I need to take advantage of any free time I can to let my body rest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion seems rather exhausted. Maybe I need to revise her race schedule.
